But in this game, Magnus was going to play with the black pieces. And despite that, he managed to still outplay Gash in a complicated Italian game. And after a very long and complicated scramble, he landed in this position where black is completely winning with the right play. But unfortunately, both players don't have a lot of time left on the clock. And in this position, with only 47 seconds on the clock, Magnus made a big mistake and played knight check, allowing Gash to sacrifice his rook to win both of Magnus' pieces. Here, Magnus was still hoping that he could promote one of his black pawns. But Gash demonstrated how to masterfully rotate a knight to stop both of the pawns with the collaboration of his white king. And in this position, Magnus decided to resign the game by slamming his king down. The point is that the king and the knight collaborate to win one of black's pawn.
